notes: Official publishers only -- statistical agencies, ministries, and the intergovernmental bodies that publish commodity balance sheets. No aggregators, no paywalled trade press. EXCEPTION (2026-09-02, operator decision): S&P Global's own RSS feeds are allowed even though the full articles sit behind a paywall -- the feed itself (headline + short excerpt) is free, the standard shape for RSS on paywalled trade press. This is a deliberate one-off, not an opening for aggregators generally; an unverifiable site with zero independent footprint (checked and rejected the same day) stayed out specifically because this exception is not a general license.

default_country is a fallback for releases that name no country (CONAB's safra bulletins never write 'Brazil'). Any country the text does name wins over it -- a USDA release on Brazilian wheat is a Brazil report.
scope_hint 'global' marks publishers whose untagged releases are world balance sheets, not home-country news (FAO, IGC, IEA, OPEC).
commodity_hint only fires when the text mentions no commodity at all; it is a prior, not an override.

A source that 403s or moves is switched to enabled:false with the date and reason, the same convention official_reports/config/sources.json uses. feed_status in the built JSON is where you see which ones died.
